Charges will decay if Xal'atath is out of combat for more than 5 seconds.Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases all Void damage by 0.1%. Activating Void Step grants <s val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="StandardTooltipDetails">50%</s> Movement Speed and <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">25</c> Spell Armor for <s val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="StandardTooltipDetails">2</s> seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">2%</c> of her maximum Health, up to <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">10%</c>.

Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> second.<n/><n/>Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">30</c> Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.
After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.

Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">10%</c> for each pulse, stacking up to <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">5</c> times and decaying over <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">2</c> seconds.
While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">200%</c>.

Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">99</c><c val="a7a7a7" hlt-name="#ColorGray">~~0.04~~</c> damage to enemies inside and Silences them for <s val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="StandardTooltipDetails">2</s> seconds.

When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a Hero afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">5</c> seconds. Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.<n/><n/>The next Void Volley deals <c val="bfd4fd" hlt-name="#TooltipNumbers">50%</c> increased damage and costs no Mana.
